vulnerabilities.title: Risky port listening: 445
vulnerabilities.description: SMB exposed can increase risk of lateral movement and wormable exploits. What this means: Port 445 is used for Windows file sharing (SMB). If it’s open, attackers can sometimes use it to spread malware across the network. Why it matters: Open ports are like open doors on the network. Attackers scan for them to find targets.
vulnerabilities.fix: If file sharing is not needed, disable SMB/file sharing. If needed, restrict it to trusted networks, block it on Public networks, and keep Windows fully updated.

vulnerabilities.title: Potentially risky service running: LanmanServer
vulnerabilities.description: SMB Server service. If running, ensure SMB is needed and hardened. What this means: The SMB file-sharing server is running on this device. Why it matters: Unneeded services increase attack surface. If attackers find a weakness, a running service gives them something to target.
vulnerabilities.fix: If you don’t need file sharing, disable it. If needed, restrict sharing, disable SMBv1, and ensure firewall rules limit exposure.

vulnerabilities.title: Potentially risky service running: LanmanWorkstation
vulnerabilities.description: SMB client service. Typically normal; note for SMB exposure context. What this means: The SMB client component is running (normal for many systems). Why it matters: Unneeded services increase attack surface. If attackers find a weakness, a running service gives them something to target.
vulnerabilities.fix: No action needed unless you are hardening SMB across the environment.

vulnerabilities.title: Unusually low patch count
vulnerabilities.description: Low HotFix count may indicate missing cumulative updates (or limited visibility). What this means: This device has fewer recorded updates than expected. Why it matters: A low patch count can mean the system is missing updates, or that update inventory is incomplete.
vulnerabilities.fix: Run Windows Update and verify patching. If inventory is managed by IT, confirm reporting is working.

details: AV enabled/real-time status is best-effort; third-party AV reporting varies.

patches.patch_warning: Unusually low number of HotFix entries; the system may be missing updates.
